title: Affine-counit normalization of a realized diagonal/DNC orientation
statement: Fix the finite coefficient setting [def-pur-conventions]. Let f:X→Y be separated, finite type and smooth of pure relative dimension d≥0 between Noetherian finite-type k-schemes, with compactification and structure map aY:Y→Spec k. For every finite-type affine target open V choose a normalized diagonal chart D_V of [lem-pur-diagonal-orientation-refinement]. Use the ordinary dualizing object, monoidal-unit conversion, finite Tate object and comparison functors of [def-pur-diagonal-dualizing-data]. Suppose e:omega0_f≈A_X(d)[2d] is an ordinary isomorphism whose comparison image restricts to the four-factor theta_V on every such affine target open, through the canonical source and Tate pullback comparisons. Then e satisfies DiagonalOrientationNormalization of [def-pur-diagonal-dualizing-data]: on every etale coordinate diagram over Y its inverse is exactly the pullback of the ordered Kummer-normalized affine counit transpose through the canonical coefficient and source-etale locality maps. The assertion is conditional on the given realization and constructs no isomorphism.

proof.text: Induct on d to identify the ordered finite Tate coefficient with the ordinary Tate sheaf A(d) placed in degree -2d. Flatness of Tate sheaves and their literal nonnegative tensor-power equation combine the successor factors; the zero successor uses the left unitor. The given e identifies the dualizing object with the same shifted sheaf. Exact pullback preserves these bounds.

Use affineTargetDiagonalDnc to cover Y by finite-type affine opens; pull this cover back to U through j and f. On each V, invert he V and cancel unitChange and tate to express restriction of nu*(e.inv) as tate.hom followed by theta.inv followed by the pullback of unitChange.hom. Naturality of OrientationCounit.restriction transports this to the U-side. The affine counit restriction lemma identifies this local map with the restriction of nu*(coordinate).

Use naturality of comparisonPull and the bounded-below comparison Hom bijection to descend each local equality to ordinary etale maps. Cohomology in degree -2d detects maps from IsLE(-2d) to IsGE(-2d). Exact restriction commutes with cohomology and the covering inverse images are jointly faithful on module sheaves, so the two global ordinary maps agree. Postcompose with diagonalEtaleLocality.hom and cancel its inverse to obtain the normalization equation, for each t, D, N and coordinate diagram. Empty covers and d=0 use the same argument.

proof_origin.place: Steps 1--2 and combining/canonicity paragraph; explicit affine restriction calculation and shifted-heart equality detection; U5

theorem diagonalOrdinaryOrientationNormalization (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] [HasCompactification f]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (D : ∀ (V : Y.affineOpens), (V.1.ι ≫ aY).appTop.hom.FiniteType →
      OrientationRefinement.Chart P f aY d V)
    (e : P.diagonalOrdinaryDualizing f ≅ P.diagonalTwistEtale X d)
    (he :
      ∀ (V : Y.affineOpens) (hV : (V.1.ι ≫ aY).appTop.hom.FiniteType),
        (OrientationRefinement.pull P (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι).mapIso
          ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) X).mapDerivedCategory.mapIso
            ((Etale.rightDerivedUpperShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) f).mapIso
              (Etale.singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) Y).symm ≪≫
                e)) ≪≫
          OrientationRefinement.tate P (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι (f ≫ aY) d =
        OrientationRefinement.theta P f aY d V (D V hV).geometry (D V hV).betaEtale) :
    P.DiagonalOrientationNormalization d f aY e
